agent_rules: Read this manifest before locating or interpreting migrated codec benchmark payloads.
Verify the scientific source commit and SHA-256 before mixing a Drive payload with a GitHub working copy.
Treat Drive as the long-term bulk-data archive and GitHub main as the authority for code, schema semantics, methods, manifests, and frozen scientific claims.
Use QoI Stability Qualification (QSQ) in reader-facing language; A/A1/_A1 names are historical provenance or frozen-schema identifiers only.
Do not change P1-P4, thresholds, cohorts, endpoints, or certification semantics because storage location changed.
Do not infer scientific meaning from filenames alone; consult README, naming policy, and claim-evidence files.
The recommendation layer may rank only measured operating points that are QSQ-eligible and scientifically certified under the declared measurement contract.
If Drive and GitHub copies disagree byte-for-byte, stop and report a provenance mismatch rather than silently choosing one.
